title: Emerging trends in screen-printed supercapacitors for energy storage and power devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6116-6149
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00536A, Perspective
Tholkappiyan Ramachandran, Ramesh Kumar Raji, Iftikhar Hussain
Screen-printed supercapacitors offer a low-cost, scalable energy solution with fast charge–discharge. This review covers their fabrication, materials, key challenges, and potential in wearable and IoT applications.
